*   The British government banned all travel abroad.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-chronicle_of_the_20th_c.-1)  
*   German submarine _[U-803](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German\_submarine\_U-803 "German submarine U-803")_ struck a mine and sank in the [Baltic Sea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baltic_Sea "Baltic Sea") off [Swinemünde](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C5%9Awinouj%C5%9Bcie "Świnoujście").  
*   The legislative assembly of the Canadian province of [Quebec](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quebec "Quebec") voted 55-4 to adopt a motion introduced by [René Chaloult](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ren%C3%A9_Chaloult "René Chaloult") expressing disapproval of any attempt to send conscripted men overseas.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-31)  
*   [Jim Tobin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jim_Tobin "Jim Tobin") of the [Boston Braves](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_the_Boston_Braves "History of the Boston Braves") pitched a 2-0 no-hitter against the [Brooklyn Dodgers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_the_Brooklyn_Dodgers "History of the Brooklyn Dodgers"). Tobin also hit a home run during the game, becoming the third pitcher in major league history to hit a home run while throwing a no-hitter.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-32)  

*   **Born:**[Michael Fish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Fish "Michael Fish"), TV weatherman, in [Eastbourne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastbourne "Eastbourne"), Sussex, England; [Cuba Gooding, Sr.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuba_Gooding,_Sr. "Cuba Gooding, Sr."), lead singer of the soul group [The Main Ingredient](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Main_Ingredient_(band) "The Main Ingredient (band)"), in [New York City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_City "New York City") (d. 2017)
*   The first practice assault in [Exercise Tiger](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exercise_Tiger "Exercise Tiger"), a series of large-scale rehearsals for [D-Day](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Operation_Overlord "Operation Overlord"), was held on [Slapton Sands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slapton,_Devon "Slapton, Devon") in [Devon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devon "Devon"). The exercise was attacked by nine German E-boats that killed a total of 749 American servicemen. Two landing ships were sunk including [USS _LST-507_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USS_LST-507 "USS LST-507").  
*   Japanese cruiser _[Yūbari](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese\_cruiser\_Y%C5%ABbari "Japanese cruiser Yūbari")_ sank southwest of [Palau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palau "Palau") the day after being torpedoed by the American submarine _[Bluegill](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USS\_Bluegill\_(SS-242) "USS Bluegill (SS-242)")_.  
*   **Died:**[Frank Knox](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_Knox "Frank Knox"), 70, American newspaper editor, publisher and Secretary of the U.S. Navy

*   In one of the worst [friendly fire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Friendly_fire "Friendly fire") incidents of the war, [Motor Torpedo Boat PT-346](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motor_Torpedo_Boat_PT-346 "Motor Torpedo Boat PT-346") was attacked off [Rabaul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rabaul "Rabaul") by two American Marine [Corsair](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vought_F4U_Corsair "Vought F4U Corsair") planes that mistook two PT boats for Japanese gunboats. _PT-346_ was destroyed with nine men killed and nine wounded.  
*   American attacks on the Japanese air base at [Truk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chuuk_Lagoon "Chuuk Lagoon") destroyed most of the aircraft.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-davidson_and_manning-2)  
*   The Canadian destroyer [HMCS _Athabaskan_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HMCS_Athabaskan_(G07) "HMCS Athabaskan (G07)") was torpedoed and sunk in the English Channel by the German torpedo boat _T24_.  
*   Japanese submarine _[I-183](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese\_submarine\_I-183 "Japanese submarine I-183")_ was sunk south of the [Bungo Strait](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bungo_Strait "Bungo Strait") by American submarine _[Pogy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USS\_Pogy\_(SS-266) "USS Pogy (SS-266)")_.  
*   German submarine _[U-421](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German\_submarine\_U-421 "German submarine U-421")_ was bombed and sunk at the [military port of Toulon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Military_port_of_Toulon "Military port of Toulon") by an American air raid.  

*   **Born:**[Richard Kline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Kline "Richard Kline"), actor and television director, in [Queens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queens "Queens"), New York  
*   **Died:**[Billy Bitzer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billy_Bitzer "Billy Bitzer"), 70, American cinematographer; [Bernardino Machado](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernardino_Machado "Bernardino Machado"), 93, two-time President of Portugal
*   A U.S. task force of nine heavy cruisers and eight destroyers bombarded Japanese positions on [Satawan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satawan "Satawan").[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-33)  
*   The first of 500,000 [prefabricated homes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prefabricated_home "Prefabricated home") went on show in London.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-chronicle_of_the_20th_c.-1)  
*   **Born:**[Jill Clayburgh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jill_Clayburgh "Jill Clayburgh"), actress, in [New York City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_City "New York City") (d. 2010)  
*   **Died:**[Paul Poiret](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Poiret "Paul Poiret"), 65, French fashion designer

texts.34:
*   The British government banned all travel abroad.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-chronicle_of_the_20th_c.-1)  
*   German submarine _[U-803](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German\_submarine\_U-803 "German submarine U-803")_ struck a mine and sank in the [Baltic Sea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baltic_Sea "Baltic Sea") off [Swinemünde](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C5%9Awinouj%C5%9Bcie "Świnoujście").  
*   The legislative assembly of the Canadian province of [Quebec](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quebec "Quebec") voted 55-4 to adopt a motion introduced by [René Chaloult](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ren%C3%A9_Chaloult "René Chaloult") expressing disapproval of any attempt to send conscripted men overseas.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-31)  
*   [Jim Tobin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jim_Tobin "Jim Tobin") of the [Boston Braves](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_the_Boston_Braves "History of the Boston Braves") pitched a 2-0 no-hitter against the [Brooklyn Dodgers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_the_Brooklyn_Dodgers "History of the Brooklyn Dodgers"). Tobin also hit a home run during the game, becoming the third pitcher in major league history to hit a home run while throwing a no-hitter.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-32)
texts.35:
*   **Born:**[Michael Fish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Fish "Michael Fish"), TV weatherman, in [Eastbourne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastbourne "Eastbourne"), Sussex, England; [Cuba Gooding, Sr.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuba_Gooding,_Sr. "Cuba Gooding, Sr."), lead singer of the soul group [The Main Ingredient](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Main_Ingredient_(band) "The Main Ingredient (band)"), in [New York City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_City "New York City") (d. 2017)
*   The first practice assault in [Exercise Tiger](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exercise_Tiger "Exercise Tiger"), a series of large-scale rehearsals for [D-Day](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Operation_Overlord "Operation Overlord"), was held on [Slapton Sands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slapton,_Devon "Slapton, Devon") in [Devon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devon "Devon"). The exercise was attacked by nine German E-boats that killed a total of 749 American servicemen. Two landing ships were sunk including [USS _LST-507_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USS_LST-507 "USS LST-507").  
*   Japanese cruiser _[Yūbari](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese\_cruiser\_Y%C5%ABbari "Japanese cruiser Yūbari")_ sank southwest of [Palau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palau "Palau") the day after being torpedoed by the American submarine _[Bluegill](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USS\_Bluegill\_(SS-242) "USS Bluegill (SS-242)")_.  
*   **Died:**[Frank Knox](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_Knox "Frank Knox"), 70, American newspaper editor, publisher and Secretary of the U.S. Navy
texts.36:
*   In one of the worst [friendly fire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Friendly_fire "Friendly fire") incidents of the war, [Motor Torpedo Boat PT-346](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motor_Torpedo_Boat_PT-346 "Motor Torpedo Boat PT-346") was attacked off [Rabaul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rabaul "Rabaul") by two American Marine [Corsair](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vought_F4U_Corsair "Vought F4U Corsair") planes that mistook two PT boats for Japanese gunboats. _PT-346_ was destroyed with nine men killed and nine wounded.  
*   American attacks on the Japanese air base at [Truk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chuuk_Lagoon "Chuuk Lagoon") destroyed most of the aircraft.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-davidson_and_manning-2)  
*   The Canadian destroyer [HMCS _Athabaskan_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HMCS_Athabaskan_(G07) "HMCS Athabaskan (G07)") was torpedoed and sunk in the English Channel by the German torpedo boat _T24_.  
*   Japanese submarine _[I-183](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese\_submarine\_I-183 "Japanese submarine I-183")_ was sunk south of the [Bungo Strait](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bungo_Strait "Bungo Strait") by American submarine _[Pogy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USS\_Pogy\_(SS-266) "USS Pogy (SS-266)")_.  
*   German submarine _[U-421](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German\_submarine\_U-421 "German submarine U-421")_ was bombed and sunk at the [military port of Toulon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Military_port_of_Toulon "Military port of Toulon") by an American air raid.
texts.37:
*   **Born:**[Richard Kline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Kline "Richard Kline"), actor and television director, in [Queens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queens "Queens"), New York  
*   **Died:**[Billy Bitzer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billy_Bitzer "Billy Bitzer"), 70, American cinematographer; [Bernardino Machado](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernardino_Machado "Bernardino Machado"), 93, two-time President of Portugal
*   A U.S. task force of nine heavy cruisers and eight destroyers bombarded Japanese positions on [Satawan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satawan "Satawan").[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-33)  
*   The first of 500,000 [prefabricated homes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prefabricated_home "Prefabricated home") went on show in London.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_1944#cite_note-chronicle_of_the_20th_c.-1)  
*   **Born:**[Jill Clayburgh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jill_Clayburgh "Jill Clayburgh"), actress, in [New York City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_City "New York City") (d. 2010)  
*   **Died:**[Paul Poiret](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Poiret "Paul Poiret"), 65, French fashion designer
